## Problem and result

What should a learner or contributor be able to do after this change?

## Validation

List the checks actually run and the observed result. Include a regression case for behavior changes and a screenshot for visible UI changes. Say what was not checked.

## Boundaries and attribution

Mention changes to permissions, observation, model usage, memory or host compatibility. Identify reused code/assets and relevant licenses. If AI assistance materially shaped the change, say how you reviewed it.
